verdict.rationale: Unstructured's docs describe a no-code web flow: log in to Transform, upload a document, Parse it, optionally Extract structured data, then use Get Code to build an integration. That covers the core of trying parse/extract in a browser before writing code. However, the evidence never mentions drag-and-drop or describes how results are shown in the UI, and nothing independent confirms the flow. Missing for 10: documented drag-and-drop upload, documented in-browser display of parse/extract results, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: Log in to Transform, upload a document, then Parse its content. Optionally, Extract structured data and use Get Code to build an integration.
The Unstructured Pipelines workflow designer features a no-code user interface for transforming your unstructured data
